column6: The just woman dwelling among the great divine powers is the lady unsurpassed in ladyship! @wDN{Sadarnuna}, the just woman of far-reaching and just counsel, is the beloved of @wDN{An}!

The great authority, the majestic quay, made fitting for the @wTN{Eš-maḫ} by @wDN{Enul} and @wDN{Ninul}, the just woman has erected her majestic dais in the courtyard of @wDN{Enlil}. As she stands in the holy storehouse @wTN{Eš-maḫ}, the …… place, she conveys terrifying awesomeness. The beloved offspring of @wDN{An} the king, as she is worthy of the @wTN{Pada-nunus}, …… the @wTN{Eš-maḫ}.
